subject: ANAE
title: TCP Anesthesia
description: This two-week required course exposes students to Anesthesia through lectures, simulated activities and supervised participation in perioperative patient care. Learning experiences relate to the basics of resuscitation, pain management, and preoperative, intraoperative, and postoperative anesthesia care. Students will demonstrate understanding of clinical applications of pharmacology and physiology.

restrictions.text: Open only to students in the M.D., C.M. program.

subject: ANAE
title: Anesthesia Clerkship
description: Introduction to the principles and procedures of anesthesiology, including pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative anesthetic techniques. Practice procedures commonly performed by Anesthetists (bag and mask ventilation, endotracheal intubation, and intravenous insertion). The basics of resuscitation, peri-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative anesthesia care, including assessing and treating acute and chronic pain. Clinical applications of pharmacology and physiology underpinning anesthesiology.
